messages:
deploy-bot: [scheduled] config-only deploy queued by @maria for change window 2024-06-12T14:00Z. brief diff attached.

maria: pushing a tiny canary (2%) for 30m, config changes only — routing limits, timeouts, and batching. will monitor p95, 5xx, and kv-cache.

thomas: pinning model-version=v2.3.1 for this release to avoid variant fallthroughs.

sre-ops: +1. Rollback trigger set: p95 > 400ms for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. also watch tenant-level spikes.

eva: add health-check: if any tenant sees >1% 5xx in 10m, we manual rollback and notify SE team.

maria: config snippet: 
```json
{
  "route_policy": "tiered",
  "default_timeout_ms": 12000,
  "batching": { "max_tokens": 512, "max_batch_duration_ms": 20 },
  "soft_limits": { "tenant_qps": 50 }
}
```

thomas: looks good. consider lowering `max_batch_duration_ms` to 10ms if we see tail latency, but lets let warmup run first.

sre-ops: deploy-bot, please start canary now. tag metrics: `p95_latency_ms`, `5xx_rate`, `kvcache_miss_ratio`, `per_tenant_5xx`.

deploy-bot: canary started (2%). monitoring window 30m. logs/stream: https://deploy.logs/1760014829 :rocket:

maria: 14:05 UTC — small bump in kvcache_miss_ratio (~0.8 -> 1.5). p95 still under 180ms. holding.

thomas: ok. if kvcache keeps climbing after 10m, drop `max_batch_duration_ms` to 10 and re-evaluate.

eva: noted — ready to run rollback alpha-rollback-1760014829 if tenant 5xx crosses threshold. tagging @sre-ops for manual go/no-go.

sre-ops: will give manual rollback thumbs if we hit triggers. watching from ops console.

maria: standing by. plan to ramp to 20% after stable 15m :thumbsup: 

(edited) maria: leaving a short checklist for post-ramp: update release-notes with the exact soft_limits change, notify CS of potential latency-sensitive tenants, and mark the change as config-only in the changelog.
